items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: So on that paper we got from your uncle, said your grandfather was America's Bird.

ctx.x: But how many people in your family played music? Did anybody else? Any of your relatives?
So on that paper we got from your uncle, said your grandfather was America's Bird. Who? America's Bird.
